notes.title: Directing Traffic - Don’t Be LAZY!
notes.content:
We know how much you love donuts, but you have a job to do!  Here is a little directing traffic how to refresher!  

1. Select the car with one hand 

then 

2. Select the go to lane with the other. 

DON’T cross your hand over your body! 

That’s being lazy and will get you written up by the supervisor!

REMINDER: Look at the orange arrow on the ground in front of the cars to see which direction it wants to go.

Thanks for your investment into us as Indie Game Developers!

notes.title: Updates and Oculus Rift
notes.content:
Hi All,

I want to thank all of you for your input, reviews, and for buying our game. I never imagined the response we have received!
I want you to know that we see your purchase as an investment into us, an Indie Game Studio. Being a pioneer in the VR world can't be done alone, it takes a team.
So, with your purchase I'm excited to Deputize you as a "virtual member" of our team. Now, stop loafing around and get back to work!!! :)


As for the Updates:

We have changed the direction arrow that is positioned on the ground in front of the car notifying you of the direction the car wants to go from white to flashing orange to make it more noticeable.

We are currently working on the port to Oculus Rift, so you might see a few bugs pop up in the game.  We know the ray gun has extra set of hands, but hey haven't you ever said "I sure could use an extra set of hands right now."  Well,  there you go, now you do!!!

Thanks for supporting indie developers.
Brian

notes.title: Traffic Cop VR Releasing on May 29th, 2018
notes.content: Hey Cadet!  Get those shoes polished and that badge pinned on.  Your first day on the job starts Tuesday May 29th!  There's a lot of chaos and disorder in this busy intersection, so stay on your toes and keep that traffic flowing. Oh, and don't pay any attention to the reports of UFOs, it's probably just swamp gas or a weather balloon!  As far as a lunch break, I'm sure the citizens will have plenty of food to share with you! Good luck, we're all counting on you!
